newsitem.title: UK: Two bid for UK Channel 5 text licences.
newsitem.headline: Two bid for UK Channel 5 text licences.

text.p: A consortium owned by BSkyB and Channel 5 is one of two applicants for the licence to run text services alongside the new Channel 5 TV station, Britain's Independent Television Commission (ITC) said on Friday.
The other application has come from a unit of Teletext Holdings Limited, controlled by the Daily Mail & General Trust Plc.
Sky Five Text, the C5/BSkyB venture, has tabled a cash bid of 1.5 million pounds against 313,000 pounds from rival Text 5.
The cash bid is one of a number of criteria considered by the ITC in awarding the 10-year licence.
Channel 5, a new terrestrial television channel, is due to begin broadcasting on March 30.
Channel 5 is owned by a consortium of Pearson Plc, United News & Media Plc, European broadcast group CLT-Ufa and U.S investment firm Warburg Pincus.
